description.p: BNK Launch is a launcher for Wayland compositors that support the layer shell. It is bound to a hotkey: type to search the installed applications, and press Enter to start the one at the top.

Results are ranked by relevance and by what was launched recently. The input field carries a caret, selection, and the system clipboard. Text is drawn with the session's own fonts, and the window follows the colours set in the configuration file.
